mutation.m1.person.no_e05_schedule_a_ref: Mutation fixture (the exception 05 limit of a person with no exception 05 amount, on a return whose Schedule A line 4 cannot be figured), inputs of mutation.t2.person.simple_nonelective_excess unchanged (its AGI, and so Schedule A line 4, is refused by a sale that does not qualify for Schedule D line 1a); expected values predicted by hand from the archived i5329 before running the evaluator: no Form 1099-R amount is claimed under exception 05 (unreimbursed medical expenses), so the exception 05 amount, which is limited to the medical expenses deductible on Schedule A, is $0 whatever Schedule A line 4 is (person.x_c05 $0), and the return's total of exception 05 amounts is $0 (s2.e05_total).
mutation.m1.person.spouse_no_deferrals_e: Mutation fixture (the excess-deferral screen on Form 8880 line 2 of a spouse with no elective deferrals), inputs of mutation.eic.mfj_two_children_60000 with the taxpayer's W-2 box 12 code D raised to $22,000 (with code AA $2,000, $24,000 of deferrals, over the $23,500 limit) and Yes to 'In 2025, did you (or, on a joint return, your spouse) put more of your pay into retirement plans at work than the yearly limit?'; expected value predicted by hand from the archived f8880 before running the evaluator: the spouse's Form W-2 shows nothing in box 12, so the spouse has no elective deferrals, none over the limit, and the spouse's line 2 amount (deferrals, voluntary contributions and SIMPLE salary reductions) is $0 (person[spouse].sav_line2); the excess is the taxpayer's, whose line 2 is refused.
mutation.m1.ira.special_fellowship: Mutation fixture (the IRA special-cases screen, one item at a time), inputs of stage16.refuse.ira.special with its defaults stated, the deferred compensation item answered No and the fellowship item Yes ('Did you (or your spouse on a joint return) receive taxable non-tuition fellowship or stipend payments not reported on a Form W-2?'); expected value as in that case: p590a p. 6, What Is Compensation?, such payments are treated as compensation for IRA purposes, which the IRA Deduction Worksheet of i1040gi p. 95 does not handle, so the IRA deduction special cases refusal applies (person[taxpayer].ira_line11, gate ira.special_gate).
mutation.m1.ira.special_reservist: Mutation fixture (the IRA special-cases screen, one item at a time), inputs of stage16.refuse.ira.special with its defaults stated, the deferred compensation item answered No, and Yes to the armed forces question and to the repayment of a qualified reservist distribution; expected value as in that case: i1040gi p. 95, Line 20, 'Don’t include any repayments of qualified reservist distributions', which the worksheet does not otherwise handle, so the IRA deduction special cases refusal applies (person[taxpayer].ira_line11, gate ira.special_gate).
mutation.m1.ira.special_care_payments: Mutation fixture (the IRA special-cases screen, one item at a time), inputs of stage16.refuse.ira.special with its defaults stated, the deferred compensation item answered No and the difficulty of care payments item Yes; expected value as in that case: difficulty of care payments used to increase the nondeductible contribution limit (p590a) are outside the IRA Deduction Worksheet, so the IRA deduction special cases refusal applies (person[taxpayer].ira_line11, gate ira.special_gate).
mutation.m1.ssb.ira_covered: Mutation fixture (the Social Security Benefits Worksheet exception for a traditional IRA contribution while covered by a plan), inputs of stage10.refuse.pub915 with its defaults stated, the repayment item answered No, and Yes to 'Did you (or, on a joint return, your spouse) put money into a traditional IRA for 2025 while covered by a retirement plan at work or through self-employment?', with the IRA facts that say so (an IRA, a $3,000 traditional contribution, covered by a plan at work); expected value predicted by hand from the archived i1040gi before running the evaluator: p. 31, Lines 6a and 6b, Exception, the worksheet in the instructions does not apply to a person who made traditional IRA contributions and was covered by a retirement plan; use Pub. 915 or 590-A: line 6b is refused (gate ssb.pub915).
